gates.evidence: The proposal targets 'Chats Home' (s01), which is the main chat interface and is SFW.
The reward is for watching a 15-second game, not for clicks, installs, or ratings, and is in-app usage quota (r3).
The offer is an opt-in 'Daily tasks' incentive without any hostage, loss, or 'support us' language.
The proposal uses a dedicated sheet (ns1) with an explicit 'Play task' CTA.
The body copy explicitly states 'Play a 15-second sponsored game to get 1 extra AI message.'
The proposal offers a 'Close' button to exit without penalty.
The offer is placed as a badge on the Chats Home screen (s01), not within an ongoing chat.
The eligibility criteria explicitly states 'never shown to subscribers.'

scores.evidence: The trigger is a proactive hub (Chats Home), which provides lower intent than a reactive refill, though it builds a healthy habit.
The integration is native to Luzia, using the Game Partner mechanic; it is additive and preserves the conversation flow.
Non-payer gating, daily caps, and clear exclusion of subscribers make this highly safe.
COGS ($0.0018) is roughly 20% of net revenue ($0.009), providing a healthy margin.
Chats Home is the core hub (13 visits during exploration) ensuring high visibility.
Uses standard SIM-RWD component, simple badge element, and remote config.
Uses Luzia persona, Chats Home (s01), and the specific AI Usage Quota resource (r3).
Strict daily cap of 3 tasks prevents nagging.
Explicitly names primary metrics, guardrails, and a user-level holdout as per MEAS-5.
